heard: We blamed the full moon for spikes in human madness. Many police and emergency doctors still believe the moon causes chaos. Researchers analyzed 30 years of hospital and police records. They tracked emergency visits across every single lunar phase. Full moon admissions were identical to four normal lunar days. Apparent surges are just weekend traffic patterns in disguise. Decades of meta-analyses prove the real correlation is zero. Moonlight guides marine coralspawning, yet leaves human behavior untouched. Data shows no link to crime, births, or sudden hospital surges.
